## Carga de librerías

```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(here, readr, tidyverse, kableExtra, broom, modelsummary, marginaleffects)
```

## Carga de datos

```{r}
censo <- read.csv(
  here("TP3", "data", "adult_census_USA.csv"))
```

## Transformación de variable

```{r}
censo <- censo %>%
  mutate(
    income = factor(income, levels = c("<=50K", ">50K"))
  )
```

## Limpieza de base

```{r}
censo <- censo %>%
  select(
    age, education_num, marital_status, race, sex, hours_per_week, income) %>% 
  mutate(
    marital_status = if_else(
      marital_status %in% c(
        "Married-civ-spouse",
        "Married-spouse-absent",
        "Married-AF-spouse"),
      "married",
      "single"))
```

## Verificación de balance

```{r}
prop.table(table(censo$income))
```

## Visualizaciones bivariadas

```{r}
ggplot(censo, aes(x = sex, fill = income)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribución de Ingresos según Género",
    x = "Género",
    y = "Proporción",
    fill = "Ingresos"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(censo, aes(x = income, y = hours_per_week, fill = income)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Horas Trabajadas por Semana según Nivel de Ingresos",
    x = "Ingresos",
    y = "Horas por Semana"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
ggplot(censo, aes(x = marital_status, fill = income)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  labs(
    title = "Efecto de Interacción: Estado Civil y Género sobre el Ingreso",
    x = "Estado Civil",
    y = "Proporción",
    fill = "Ingresos"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Regresión logística

### Modelo 1

```{r}
modelo_base <- glm(income ~ age + education_num + marital_status + race + sex + hours_per_week,
                   data = censo, family = binomial)

stargazer::stargazer(modelo_base, type = "text", star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), 
                     report = "vc*sp", no.space = T)
```

### Modelo 2

```{r}
modelo_interativo <- glm(income ~ age + education_num + marital_status*sex + race + hours_per_week, 
                         data = censo, family = binomial)

stargazer::stargazer(modelo_interativo, type = "text", star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001), 
                     report = "vc*sp", no.space = T)
```

## Resultados y efectos marginales

### Tabla efectos marginales promedio (Modelo 2)
```{r}
ame_modelo <- avg_slopes(modelo_interativo) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(term, contrast, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  mutate(term = case_match(
    term,
    "age"            ~ "Edad (Años)",
    "education_num"  ~ "Nivel Educativo (Años)",
    "marital_status" ~ "Estado Civil",
    "sex"            ~ "Género",
    "hours_per_week" ~ "Horas Trabajadas por Semana",
    "race"           ~ "Etnia"))

ame_modelo %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Tabla 2. Efectos Marginales Promedio (AME) — Modelo 2 (Interactivo)",
    digits  = 4,
    format  = "html",
    align   = c("l", "l", rep("c", 5))) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "gray", color = "white")

```

### Gráfico *forest plot*
```{r}
coeficientes_plot <- broom::tidy(modelo_interativo) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    estimado      = exp(estimate),
    low_99  = exp(estimate - 2.576 * std.error),
    high_99 = exp(estimate + 2.576 * std.error),
    low_95  = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    high_95 = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
    low_80  = exp(estimate - 1.282 * std.error),
    high_80 = exp(estimate + 1.282 * std.error),
    etiqueta = case_match(
      term,
      "age"                           ~ "Edad (Años)",
      "education_num"                 ~ "Nivel Educativo (Años)",
      "hours_per_week"                ~ "Horas semanales trabajadas",
      "marital_statussingle"          ~ "Estado Civil: Soltero/a",
      "sexMale"                       ~ "Género: Masculino",
      "raceAsian-Pac-Islander"        ~ "Raza: Asiático/Isleño",
      "raceAmer-Indian-Eskimo"        ~ "Raza: Amerindio/Eskimo",
      "raceOther"                     ~ "Raza: Otra",
      "raceWhite"                     ~ "Raza: Blanco",
      "marital_statussingle:sexMale"  ~ "Interacción: Soltero × Masculino"),
    significativo = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Sig. (p<0.05)", "No sig."))

ggplot(coeficientes_plot,
       aes(
         x = estimado,
         y = reorder(etiqueta, estimado),
         color = significativo)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "gray40",
    linewidth  = 0.7) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = low_99, xmax = high_99),
    linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = low_95, xmax = high_95),
    linewidth = 1.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = low_80, xmax = high_80),
    linewidth = 2.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Sig. (p<0.05)" = "#08519C", "No sig." = "#CB181D"),
    name   = "Significancia") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title    = "Forest Plot - Modelo Interactivo",
    subtitle = "Odds Ratios con barras de error graduadas (80%, 95% y 99%). Censo USA",
    x        = "Odds Ratio (Escala Logarítmica)",
    y        = NULL,) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
